name: UntrustedXlsxBoundary
pre_open_checks: verify file signature/container is ZIP-based OOXML compatible with .xlsx; password/encrypted ZIP is unsupported
read central directory without extracting to filesystem
normalize every ZIP part name and reject absolute paths, parent traversal, backslash/alternate separator ambiguity, duplicate normalized part names and alternate-stream/device-like names
require supported workbook/content-type relationships and reject macro-enabled/VBA project/ActiveX/OLE embedded executable/package parts
reject external workbook/data/attachedTemplate/hyperlink relationships that require fetching or executing an external resource; ordinary inert hyperlink text is not followed
reject XML parts containing DOCTYPE or ENTITY declarations before XML parsing
parse_mode: parse only supported OOXML workbook, relationships, sharedStrings, styles needed for date interpretation and worksheet XML
use streaming/event parsing and bounded text accumulation; no formula engine exists in the import path
formula cells in a registered semantic matrix column are unsupported and fail the affected workbook because cached results are not accepted as independent source facts
formula cells outside the semantic matrix are security-scanned/resource-counted but carry no domain meaning and are never evaluated
macros/scripts/data connections/executable embedded content are never executed and unsupported active content causes safe failure before staging publication
matrix_discovery: scan worksheets in workbook order for a header row whose normalized cells resolve through the source-family header registry and include all required identity headers
header search is bounded to the first 100 nonempty physical rows per worksheet
exactly one logical matrix is accepted per source family workbook in V1; zero is SOURCE_MATRIX_NOT_FOUND and more than one is SOURCE_MATRIX_AMBIGUOUS
outside-matrix cells receive security/resource scanning only and are not persisted/fingerprinted as domain data
date_rules: Excel numeric dates are converted only when the resolved field contract is temporal and the workbook date-system/style combination is supported
text timestamps use strict source-profile parser; explicit offset wins, otherwise America/Guayaquil for RFC/WFM operational row times
the Excel 1900 leap-year compatibility quirk is handled by the selected parser contract and covered by golden fixtures; invalid/ambiguous values become field findings rather than guessed times
failure: Any workbook-level security/container/matrix integrity failure marks the ImportRun failed and publishes no staged proposal/domain mutation. Resource-limit failure never produces a partial accepted parse.
